name: Ninja Guide
body:
A ninja guide helps lead others in their infiltrations and subterfuge.

Coordination (Ex)

At 2nd level, a ninja guide gains a +20 circumstance bonus to Perception checks to see or hear their allies and Sense Motive to interpret signs or codes from them. At 10th level, they constantly benefit from the status spell for all allies within 100 feet.

This ability replaces the ninja trick gained at 2nd level.

Skill Teamwork (Ex)

At 4th level, a ninja guide grants some competence in skills to their, non-self, allies. All allies within 30 feet gain a +2 competence bonus on Acrobatics, Climb, Escape Artist, Perception, and Stealth. If a ninja guide has 10 ranks in any of the listed skills, the bonus provided increases to +4 for those skills.

This ability replaces uncanny dodge.

Teamwork Tracelessness (Ex)

At 4th level, a ninja guide can provide their no trace bonuses to all allies within 30 feet.

This ability replaces the ninja trick gained at 4th level.

Flanking Teamwork (Ex)

At 8th level, when a ninja guide flanks a target, they and all allies who threaten the same target gain a +1 circumstance bonus on their attack rolls against the target. This is in addition to the normal flanking bonuses.

This ability replaces improved uncanny dodge.

Team Sneak Attack (Ex)

At 8th level, a ninja guide grants 1/2 of their sneak attack dice to any allies who are flanking the same creature. This cannot increase the ally’s sneak attack dice above the ninja guide’s own.

This ability replaces the ninja trick gained at 8th level.

Break Away (Ex)

At 10th level, a ninja guide gains a +4 dodge bonus to AC on any turn in which they do nothing but move. This can be granted to an ally within 30 feet as a swift action for 1 round.

This ability replaces the ninja trick gained at 10th level.
